recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-5508 unless Pharmacy later changes the author versus informationSource distinction.
issue_request: FHIR-5508 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 MedicationStatement. The ballot comment asked for clear identification of the practitioner responsible for an original medication reconciliation entry; the resolution rejected MedicationStatement.author for that purpose and agreed to add MedicationStatement.informationSource to capture where the statement information came from.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly names FHIR-5508. Historical commit abce09d8c1edffa07e8bd6fbdf60eaa097da3d91, committed one day after the Jira comments, updated the old MedicationStatement spreadsheet source and added MedicationStatement.informationSource as Reference(Patient | Practitioner | RelatedPerson) with definition text saying it was the person who provided the medication-taking information.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition contains informationSource with source-oriented wording and target profiles for Device, Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, RelatedPerson, Organization, and Group. It also contains author, but later Applied issue FHIR-41760 explicitly decided that informationSource is not author and added author as a distinct element. FHIR-41500 was already reconciled on the combined branch and clarified informationSource wording after adding Device.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current build-scope source already includes the informationSource concept requested by FHIR-5508 and treats author as a later, separate concept.
